reason: Everything already runs on WhatsApp and customers pay me on UPI, so it works fine as it is. Paying ₹4,999 upfront and then ₹999 every month just to make my staff take selfies and type numbers into a new app feels like extra work, not less.
objection: If this app or company shuts down, or my phone breaks, where does my customer list go? At least in WhatsApp I know where everything is. I don't want to pay ₹5,000 before I even know my girls will use it.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee: let me use it free for a month first, and show me my customer data is backed up and that I can download it any time even if I stop paying.
